claims.statement: NEXY security requirements prohibit unnecessary plaintext secrets/PII in logs and require fail-closed handling.
At target HEAD, packages/auth/email.ts ConsoleEmailProvider writes raw destination email and raw OTAC code to stderr and is selectable by EMAIL_PROVIDER=console or NODE_ENV=development.

objectives: Eliminate plaintext OTAC codes and destination email addresses from stdout/stderr/log output on every ConsoleEmailProvider/development path.
If console/development mode has no real secure delivery mechanism, fail closed with a non-sensitive error instead of reporting a successful OTAC delivery after logging or discarding the code.
acceptance_criteria: No execution path in packages/auth/email.ts writes, logs, throws, or otherwise exposes the raw OTAC code or raw destination email to stdout/stderr/log sinks.

Console/development mode cannot report successful delivery unless the code is actually delivered through a non-log delivery mechanism; otherwise sendOtac rejects without embedding the email/code in the error.
SMTP provider continues to send the OTAC to the destination through nodemailer and no HTTP-response behavior is changed by this command.
A focused regression test uses sentinel email/code values and proves they do not appear in stdout/stderr or thrown error text.
No files outside allowed_change_surface are modified.
negative_tests: Set EMAIL_PROVIDER=console with sentinel email and OTAC; assert sentinel values are absent from captured stdout/stderr and rejection/error text.
Set NODE_ENV=development without a secure delivery provider; assert sendOtac does not falsely resolve after dropping the code.
security_checks: Search the changed source/test diff for plaintext OTAC logging patterns and raw destination-email logging.
Confirm no secret/credential values are added to fixtures, snapshots, evidence or error messages.
expected_evidence: focused negative test output proving raw email/code are absent from log/error capture
rollback: Revert only the command commit(s) if focused tests, typecheck, lint or security checks fail.
Do not restore plaintext secret logging as an operational fallback.
stop_conditions: Any required change appears to require a forbidden path
A secret/credential is encountered in repository/tool output
Required test would need weakening/deletion to pass
The proposed fix would make OTAC delivery falsely succeed without secure delivery

next_action: Refresh target branch HEAD and claim the READY command only if it still equals expected_head.
Apply the smallest in-scope repair and execute all required/negative/regression/security checks.
Return a BUILDER_TO_AUDITOR package; do not self-approve.
